Senses.Explanation: The original Mazu-circle and Jingshan-dot case turns one ink mark into two dragons; later masters reuse the line as an answer or an appraisal of paired actions. Guishan applies it to Mazu’s circle and Jingshan’s answering dot, Jingqing uses it to close a source-question, and Ying’an and Gulin use the image to cap later exchanges.
